description: Synthetic experiment index for the Corvo Labs proof fixture corpus. Entries mirror the markdown notebook entries in this folder.

experiments.title: Eval harness v0 — gates beat prompt iteration
experiments.hypothesis: Per-component eval gates hold regression rate flat while iteration speed stays constant.
experiments.result: Regression rate 4/10 to 1/10; failures became explainable.

experiments.title: Approval-gate telemetry — what reviewers actually catch
experiments.hypothesis: Reviewers mostly catch factual drift, not tone, so approval UIs should foreground claim lineage.
experiments.result: fact-drift was the top reason tag (21 of 47); decision time doubled without inline sources.

experiments.title: Worktree-local tracing makes agent runs debuggable
experiments.hypothesis: Per-worktree trace files beat a shared trace store for debuggability.
experiments.result: 6/6 root causes found inside the worktree; 2 traces promoted to eval fixtures.

experiments.title: Review comments convert cleanly into regression evals
experiments.hypothesis: Checkable review comments convert to eval cases in under 10 minutes and drive repeat mistakes toward zero.
experiments.result: 16/18 converted at 9-minute median; repeat-mistake rate 1-in-3 to 1-in-8.

experiments.title: Campaign-shaped batches need a cohesion gate
experiments.hypothesis: Set-level cohesion checks catch what per-post review cannot.
